justification: The strongest correspondence is the use of schematic curvilinear incised figures, apparently including bird/animal-headed human-like motifs, together with simple oval or circular signs. The biggest difference is that A is organized around a large frontal anthropomorphic body with symmetrical bodily features, while B is a scattered field of smaller petroglyph-like figures on an irregular surface with no single dominant body or fixed layout.
